title: Sell Mineral Rights in Stanley, ND
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Stanley, ND
metaDescription: Own mineral rights near Stanley, ND, the Mountrail County seat? Get title research pulled straight from the courthouse plus a straight offer.
heroLead: Stanley is the Mountrail County seat, which means the courthouse holding your family's mineral records is right here, even if nobody in the family has walked through its doors in years.
intro: That's worth mentioning because so many of the owners we talk to about Stanley-area minerals live somewhere else entirely, and the idea of the county recorder's office feels distant even though their acreage sits right inside one of the strongest parts of the Bakken. We do the courthouse work so you don't have to.

sections.heading: Stanley's position in the Bakken core
paragraphs: As the seat of a county that includes the Parshall and Sanish fields, Stanley sits close to some of the most productive Bakken acreage anywhere in the state. Mineral interests around town itself and the surrounding sections have generally seen strong development over the past fifteen years.

sections.heading: Pulling your records at the Mountrail County Recorder
paragraphs: We go directly to the Mountrail County Recorder's office in Stanley to confirm legal descriptions, ownership chains, and any recorded leases tied to your interest. That's part of our process for every owner, whether you live down the road or across the country.

sections.heading: What sits under Stanley itself and the surrounding sections
paragraphs: The town and the farmland around it fall within some of Mountrail County's strongest producing acreage, with multi-well pad development common on spacing units near town. If your family's mineral interest is close to Stanley itself, there's a real chance it's tied to several producing wellbores rather than just one.
We check the actual well count for your legal description before naming a number, since that difference matters a great deal to what a fair offer looks like.

faqs.question: Do I need to visit the Stanley courthouse myself to sell my minerals?
faqs.answer: No, we handle all the title research at the Mountrail County Recorder's office directly, and paperwork can be completed by mail wherever you live.

faqs.question: How close is our Stanley-area property to the Parshall field?
faqs.answer: It depends on your exact section. We check your specific legal description against the state's well records to answer that precisely.

faqs.question: What if the county records don't match what my family believes we own?
faqs.answer: That happens more often than you'd think, especially with older interests. We'll walk you through any discrepancy we find before making an offer.

faqs.question: How many wells could be pooled under our Stanley-area spacing unit?
faqs.answer: Send us your legal description and we'll check the state well index directly, since tracts near Stanley often have multiple wellbores across the Bakken and Three Forks.
